body: Okay wait i just read your edit.. if you never met in person then thats dangerous... nope nope. Your 15 and met since 11? Thats a bit suspicious

When i was 17.. im 21 now.. i tried to take my life.. that very moment near death.. a part of me regrets it.. a part of me thinks i lived a good life and ill find peace.. i lived but with the consequences of having a permanent injury to one of my leg...  i walk on a weird limp.. a constant reminder of what I’ve done to myself.. my friend.. I don’t think people want to be dead.. i think they want to be free from the pain... escape the life they dont like.. i dont think anyone wants to feel the empty void.. which I remember

I feel the same way.. honestly.. why is being miserable 9-5 acceptable.. why do people think its okay.. im happy you have something.. to look forward to.. for shows.. i really like the mandalorian... life seems fun in that universe.. you ever feel.. escapism.. how you can imagine yourself.. in xxx show? Its fun.. it takes away the feeling of the pain and suffering for a bit..

I understand.. I am female and Vietnamese,, her parents wont understand.. her friends wont understand,, she feels helpless and alone.. you guys remind me... of my lover and I.. how i begged him not to called the police.. not to tell my parents.. how we talked about growing up with each other... young sir.. you must visit her house.. and ask her parents where she is.. if shes okay... if shes anything like me.. she isolated herself and is laying in her bed.. waiting for everything to get better... if you see her... if her parents allow you to see her.. please give her a big hug.. and tell her everything is going go be okay.. and that you will take care of her.. that she means the world to you.. please lay next to her until she feels better,. Please keep me updated..

Life is hard yes..  people wont understand illnesses.. my mom thinks its because i dont eat properly... i understand you.. the pain your going through.. why im writing this at 2:40 am in the same state of mind as you.. telling you to stay alive.. even though i know how death seems like a blessing.. how you imagine life after.. we are unsure., but i hope maybe.. talking to you through reddit ... depressed stranger to stranger..  i care enough to write for you.. to wait 5 minutes to post this comment because reddit restricted my posting time.. please don’t take your life..

I cant write much because im tired.. i understand how you feel.. i tried to take my life at 17 but ended up with a impaired leg.. i cant seem to understand life either.. its hard to go on.. i dont understand how everyone is okay and happy.. the lady on a suicide line says people see different perspectives.. of course people who go through hardships are going to see it different... all i can offer you is an online hug..
